subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and well covered, but it intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility in A2A announce/ping-pong paths that green CI cannot fully settle for every real channel history.

options.title: Accept The Suppression Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix targets transcript bookkeeping before it can become a second visible reply.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run if deterministic Gateway/qa-channel proof is not enough for this delivery path.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Coordination
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the message-tool mirror, reverse sessions_send, and compaction duplicate variants resolved under one coordinated A2A plan.

recommendation.title: Accept The Suppression Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix targets transcript bookkeeping before it can become a second visible reply.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the closest recent history on delivery-mirror transcript provenance and the current waited A2A helper paths.
